items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: Jimmy was playing, uh, at one time with Joe Benuti... Frankie Cingarillo was playing with them with Joe Benuti and them guys... Joe Benuti was the leader of the band.

ctx.x: Well, you know, you know what a Paramount Theater, that's 42nd Street, Times Square and so forth. Well, I was living with Jimmy Darcy on 44th Street, right off, right off of 7th Avenue, where 7th Avenue is going with me to see. And, uh, Jimmy was playing, uh, at one time with Joe Benuti and, and, and Eddie Lang and those guys in the, in the pit for the, uh, oh, what the, that was the name of the show. I can't think of the name of the show. I'll think about it.
